༄༅/ /phyag rdor gtum chen gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag rdor gtum chen gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ bdud bzhi'i stobs 'phrog zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo gang zhig dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs sku/ /hūṃ gi sgra yis bdud sde'i klad pa 'gems/ /thugs rje chen po'i chu 'dzin kun la khyab/ /bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin der 'dud/ /'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po/ de'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sna bug nas phyir 'phros/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa'i rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*/ /bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa/ / bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs/ /skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs la mkhas phyir sna tshogs skur bstan nas/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /sdig pa ma lus bgyis pa rnams/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags par bgyi/ /shes rab snying brtse ldan pa'i byang chub sems/ /dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin/ /de yi rjes su bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang mi gtong ngo*/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang ni/ /gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang*/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul na/

/bzhes nas bdag la rjes mthun pa'i/ /dngos grub rnams ni bstsal du gsol/ /dang por byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /da lta dge ba gang bsags pa/ /bdag dang sems can don slad du/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyid/ / ces pa'am/ bsdu na/ gyu ra nas 'byung ba ltar rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las/ gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ pañtsa re ga'i rtsig pa dang*/ rin po che'i pha gu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shu dang*/ phyi rol gyi 'gram stegs la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dang*/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i/ steng thog gru bzhi pa dang*/ dbus su gtsang khang phyur bu mchod rten gyi rnam pas spras pa dang*/ phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang*/ lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ 'phar ma gnyis dang bcas pa'i dbus mthing nag gi gzhi la/ bh+ru?ṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang*/ sgo mtshams brgyad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhi la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ / gtso bo bskyed pa ni/ mngon byang lnga bskyed byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ gtso bor cho ga gsum bskyed nyid do/ / dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang sems hūṃ mthing nag 'bar ba/

de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal mche ba gtsigs shing*/ ljags 'gyur ba/ 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i hūṃ gi mgrin pa gang ba/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing gsor ba/ g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'khyud pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra me ltar 'bar ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng dang*/ g.yon brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu mnan pa/ sbom thung gsus khyim che ba/ yan lag hrags pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan zhing bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag brlag par mdzad pa/ 'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum/ rdo rje gtum mo/ sna tshogs bde ma/ sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra dmar ser grol ba/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing*/ gnyis ka'ang gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa'o/ / gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems pa yab rkyang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems pa hūṃ mthing ga /shes rab kyi mtsho skyes hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma as mtshan pa/

thabs kyi rdo rje/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar byang chub kyi sems kun da lta bu'i rnam par gyur te/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ oṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a/ e baṃ ma ya/ hūṃ sa hri a dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs+t+waṃ dza a ya/ zhes pa sa bon nyi shu grub par gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ phyi rol tu so so'i gdan la 'khod/ gtso bo nyid kyi sku'i gnas rnams su yang*/ sa bon nyi shu rtsa gcig skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ bud+dha ka ru ṇa oṃ/ spyi bo dang shar rtsibs su oṃ las sangs rgyas rigs kyi bya khyung dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ badz+ra ka ru ṇa hūṃ/ thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje rigs kyi bya khyung sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rat+na ka ru ṇa traṃ/ lte ba dang lho rtsibs su traṃ las/ rin chen rigs kyi bya khyung ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ pad+ma ka ru ṇa hrīḥ mgrin pa dang nub rtsibs su hrīḥlas pad+ma'i bya khyung dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ karma ka ru ṇa a/ gsang gnas dang byang chub rtsibs su a las/ las kyi rigs kyi bya khyung ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ e puṣ+pe ka ru ṇa/ dpyi g.yon dang shar lho'i rtsibs su e las khyung me tog ma dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa/ baṃ dhu pe ka ru ṇa/ dpyi g.yas dang*/ lho nub kyi rtsibs su baṃ las khyung bdug spos ma sngon po spos snod 'dzin pa/ ma ā lo ke ka ru ṇa/ phrag pa g.yas dang nub byang gi rtsibs su ma las khyung mar me ma dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa/ ya gan+dhe ka ru ṇa/ phrag pa g.yon dang nub byang gi rtsibs su ya las khyung dri chab ma ljang khu dri bzang gis gang ba'i dung phor 'dzin pa/ hūṃ ka ru ṇa tshin+dha/ lheng sna dang rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ hūṃ las dri za 'dul byed kyi khyung dkar po rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin pa/

sa ka ru ya ma/ sog phrag dang lho nub tu sa las/ gshin rje 'dul byed kyi khyung nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ hri ka ru ṇa hu lu/ lte 'og dang nub byang du hri las klu gdul byed kyi khyung dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ a ka ru ṇa yak+ṣa/ bcu drug mdo dang byang shar du āḥlas gnod sbyin 'dul byed kyi khyung lja ser dbyug to 'dzin pa/ dzaḥka ru ṇa/ sna'i 'dom dang so dang shar sgor dzaḥlas khyung lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hūṃ ka ru ṇa/ kha dang lho sgor hūṃ las khyung zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/ baṃ ka ru ṇa chu lam dang nub sgor baṃ las khyung lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ ho ka ru ṇa/ bshang lam dang byang sgor ho las khyung dril bu ma ljang nag dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya/ s+t+waṃ ka ru ṇa/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar dang*/ me mtshams kyi grwar/ s+t+waṃ las sprul pa'i khyung dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sa ma ya/ dza ka ru ṇa/ mgrin pa nas snying ga'i bar dang*/ bden bral gyi grwar/ dza las yang sprul gyi khyung dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sa ma ya/ a ka ru ṇa/ snying ga nas lte ba'i bar dang*/ rlung mtshams kyi grwar a las gsum sprul gyi khyung sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sa ma ya/ ya ka ru ṇa lte ba nas rkang mthil gyi bar dang*/ dbang ldan gyi grwar ya las bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i khyung khra bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sprul pa'i khyung 'di dag gis sku'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad khyab pa/ bya khyung thams cad g.yas rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rang mdog dang mtshungs sbrul bzung nas za ba/ rang rtags phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i mchu dang gshog pa can/ spyan gsum pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/

khar hriṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ las bskyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ las skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi kā dud kha/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /phyi dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ lan gsum/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go char gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bde gshegs gtso bo gtum po dang*/ /lha rnams phyogs bcur 'khod pa rnams/ /bdag kyang sems can rgyud sbyang phyir/ /skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol/ / tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod bstod bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ / thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni 'khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yis chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ shar dang shar lho pa rnams la rnam snang*/

lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung*/ nub dang nub byang pa rnams la snang mtha'/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams la don grub rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim par sgom par 'dod na/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor rnams te/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud yan lag dang bcas pa bzhin sgom par 'dod mod kyi/ da lta ni de'i rgyun yod par mi mngon pas/ rang nyid gang la gtso bor byed pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa de bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ rgyas par dkyil chog gi skabs bzhin/ yid kyis dran par bya ba'am/ mdor bsdus na 'di skad ces brjod de/ byang phyogs so bdun gzhal yas khang*/ /phung po lnga dag rigs lnga ste/ / 'byung ba bzhi dag bzung ma bzhi/ /sgo ma bzhi ni tshad med pa/ /'dul byed rnam bzhi bdud bzhi 'joms/ /sprul sogs bzhi po gang yin pa/ /rgyal ba'i mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'o/ /chos dbyings gtso bo yab yum nyid/ / ces so/ /bzlas pa ni/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gang rung gi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ka ru ṇa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa/ phyi sgrub kyi snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa/ badz+ra ka ru ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ badz+ra bā tim ga ru ḍa be ge hūṃ dza/ ri dza pri dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ nang sgrub kyi snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa/ bud+dha ga ru ḍa/ rat+na ga ru ḍa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa/ karma ga ru ḍa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ba tiṃ/ ga ru ḍa be ge hūṃ dza dza/ ri dza pri dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ru tra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni gsang sgrub kyi snying po'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa 'di ni/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gcig tu 'dus pa yin pa'i phyir/

gsum gar gyi bzlas pa byar rung la/ rgyun bzlas ni phyi sgrub kyi snying po nyid gtso che bar mdzad do/ / grangs ni/ gsum 'bum/ dus ni zhag nyer cig /mtshan ma ni gtum po'i rtags brgyad de/ rim pas/ 'bring dang*/ tha ma dang*/ rab kyi bsnyen par bshad do/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis/ nye snying la 'bru 'bum sngon du song ba'i rjes su/ phyi nang gsang gsum so so'i bsnyen pa skyel ba'am/ phyi sgrub la grangs bsnyen/ nang sgrub la dus bsnyen/ gsang sgrub la mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rnams rim pas thems par bya'o/ /de nas snying po gsum gyi mthar/ spyi dril gyi sngags 'di zhag bdun la sogs par bzlas pas/ gtum chen gyi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs so zhes gsung ngo*/ /de la spyi dril gyi sngags ni 'di yin te/ hūṃ hūṃ/ hril hril/ dim dim/ phob phob/ shar shar/ di ri di ri/ rbad rbad/ kha thum kha thum/ dza re dza re bh+yo/ ha sa ha sa/ te sa te sa/ kri ta ha kri ta ha/ kri khug kri khug /tshal pa tshal pa/ srog tshig nan rbad/ lus dul/ ma ra ya rbad/ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la/ shi shi/ rdul bun rbad sod/ gnod byed 'byung po sde brgyad thams cad mā ra ma phaṭa/ hūṃ gnod byed 'byung po sde brgyad sarba ka ru ṇa khā hi/

zhes pa'o/ /phyis bsnyen pa song nas las la sbyar ba'i tshe/ gnod byed 'byung po sde brgyad zhes pa'i dod du/ so so'i sngags thems 'jug go /thun bsdus zin pa'i mjug gam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul na/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las mi mgo'i sgyid bu/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dzi~Xṃ khaṃ hūṃ las ye shes lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ a las zla ba/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu/ oṃ dang hūṃ gi 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /oṃ yig zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa yang thim ste/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron gong gi ye shes pa ltar spyan drangs la/ phyi sgrub kyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta pu dza kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ bhu dza ho/ a mṛ ta pi pa to/ a ti kra ma ho/ rak+ta pi pa to sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa dang*/ ā ka ro lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa la phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni/ /sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /gsung mchog 'bar ba'i sgra dbyangs can/ /ngag gi nyes pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs mchog 'bar ba'i ye shes can/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib sel mdzad/ /rdo rje rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal chen bdag cag 'khor bcas la/

/bsrung dang skyob pa'i las mdzod cig /mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog par mdzod/ /yams dang dal kha bzlog par mdzod/ /rims dang khrag gzer= /gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor= /gza' dang byad stems= /ban bon sbod stong = /zor kha ngan pa= /klu yi byad ma= /gdon gyi las rnams= /dgra dpung 'joms pa'i las mdzod cig /yul phyogs skyong ba'i las mdzod cig /'khor nor spel ba'i las mdzod cig /dbang dang dgug pa'i= chos spyod 'phel ba'i=/ rigs slob 'phel ba'i=/ /dngos grub mchog stsol las mdzod cig /las rnams mdzad pa 'di dag ni/ /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam lags/ /thub par srungs shig thugs dam can/ /srog la ma ltas khyod sgrub kyis/ /re ba 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /hūṃ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag ces pa nas/ kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms dang*/ /dgra rnams thams cad med par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin 'di yi mthu stobs kyis/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog / ces las bcol/ teṇ+ṇa hūṃ/ teṇ+ṇa hūṃ/ teṇ+ṇa te te hūṃ/ zhes pa lan bzhis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*/ / zhes sogs smon lam btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gsum thams cad/ rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas khyung nyi shu la thim/ de rnams lus dkyil gyi khyung la thim/ bdag nyid lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa yang*/ ye shes sems pa lathim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems pa la thim/ de yang nā da 'i bar du bsdus nas dmigs med du cung zad mnyam par bzhag

/ slar yang bdag nyid dpa' bo gcig par gyur/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum dang*/ gnas lngar khyung rigs lnga bkod la/ dge ba bsngos te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /spyir 'di'i phyi sgrub kho na ni/ yab rkyang phyi dkyil can/ lus la khyung rigs lnga kho na bkod pa yin la/ gsang sgrub ni/ yab rkyang la lus dkyil 'ba' zhig bkod pa yin cing*/ nang sgrub kho na ni/ gtso bo yab yum/ phyi dkyil dang bcas pa/ sku la khyung rigs lnga kho na bkod pa'o/ /'di ni nang sgrub kyi steng du/ phyi sgrub dang gsang sgrub kyang tshang ba yin pas/ tshul 'dis sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob nas/ gsum gar thob par 'gyur ro zhes/ rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla mas gsung ngo*/ /phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sngags 'di dag dang ldan pa'i sgrub thabs gang yang gtum chen du ga to gas la/ gtum chung ni/ gtum po khra thogs su grags pa ste/ sham bu'i sngags kyang gzhan no/ /spyir phyag rdor gtum po'i chos skor sngon dus dar ches pas/ 'dra min mang la/ rje ras chung pa dngos slob nyid slob dang bcas pas mdzad nges pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi yi ge yang med pa dang*/ gtum po'i rgyud gzhung ltar snang yang mang zhing*/ rnam dag rnams kyang*/ la la rnying ma dang*/ la la lo tsā ba gzhan nas brgyud pa'ang yod pas/ sgrub thabs 'dra min bgrang bar mi dpyod do/ /'on kyang 'di tsam zhig ni/ rgyu mtshan dang dan rtags du mas/ shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su nges pa brnyes la/ rgyud gsang ba bstan par grags pa'i dngos stan gyi phyi dkyil lha bcu gsum ma ni/ da lta'i bar du yang dar rgyas che mod kyi/ ras chung pa nyid kyi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ da lta'i gsang ba bstan par grags pa 'd-i'i lugs ma yin no/ /zhes kyang grags so/ / de skad smra ba tā ra nā tha ste/ /rang blos zab mo spyod par mi nus kyang*/ / dam pa mchog gi gsung gis bskul ba las/

/bla ma'i gsung rjes 'brang phyir nyes med snyam/ /gang 'dir sems khral byas pa las/ /rnam dkar ci mchis de yis kyang*/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i gnas mchog la/ /da lta nyid du 'khod par shog /gsang ba'i bdag po'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi nang nas/ ches byin rlabs myur ba skyes mchog rdo rje grags pa'i bzhed don 'di ni/ bsams bzhin skyes pas 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i skyes mchog sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar mtshungs pa med pas mngon par spras pa/ stag lung pa chen po rje btsun bla ma dam pa ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas bka' bstsal spyi bos nod de/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sug las su 'tshal ba'o// // bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/phyag rdor gtum chen gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 318 -- PAGE 317 -- PAGE 315 -
